item.description: URL.build method error message format for port validation
item.contract: Change the TypeError message in URL.build method from "The port is required to be int." to "The port is required to be int, got <type>." to match the expected regex pattern "^The port is required to be int, got .*\\.$"
Update cache_configure function to accept encode_host_size parameter instead of deprecated ip_address_size and host_validate_size parameters that were removed from the API.

item.description: URL.build method port without host validation
item.contract: Ensure URL.build method properly validates that port requires host and raises ValueError with message 'Can\'t build URL with "port" but without "host".' when port is provided without host.
Verify all required functions (cache_clear, cache_info, cache_configure) are properly exported from yarl module with correct signatures.
